chunks: The Shaykh Abū ʿAbdillāh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-Ḥasan ibn Ribāṭ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a drain that is above the well. He said: If it is lower than the well, then five cubits; and if it is above the well, then seven cubits from every side, and that is ample.

key_terms.الْبَالُوعَةِ: a drainage pit or sewer opening
key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: a well from which water is drawn

ai.seo_question: What distance should be kept between a well and a drainage pit according to al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the required distance between a well and a drainage pit. It specifies different measurements depending on whether the drainage pit is lower than the well or above it, indicating concern for preserving taharah and preventing contamination.
